_doc: Renamed skills. Each key is an old skill id and its value is the current one. The bundle build expands every entry into an exact old-id -> new-id alias for the skill and each of its reference docs (old/<ref> -> new/<ref>), and writes them to the bundle's `aliases` field. A consumer such as the Runpod MCP server resolves an old id through `aliases` before reporting it unknown. Keep an entry for at least one major release after its rename. A key must not be a current guide id, and its value must be one.
